hierarchy: robot_arm > {arm_pedestal, arm_base > arm_j1 > arm_j2 > arm_j3 > gripper > {finger_L, finger_R}}

rig.arm_base: yaw about local Y; origin on the vertical axis at y=0.38 (top of pedestal)
rig.arm_j1: shoulder pitch about local X; origin on the shoulder axis (0, 0.66, 0)
rig.arm_j2: elbow pitch about local X; origin on the elbow axis (0, 1.41, 0)
rig.arm_j3: wrist pitch about local X; origin on the wrist axis (0, 1.41, 0.75)
rig.gripper: roll about local Y; origin at the tool flange (0, 1.25, 0.75)
rig.finger_L/R: translate along local X: open +-0.03 m (L +X, R -X); origin at the finger root
